english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an evening dinner, including when that evening meal is the main meal of the day.

exampleSentences.english: What should we have for dinner?

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for an ordinary evening meal.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 sik6 maan5 faan6

english.note: Use this when English tea means the main evening meal rather than the drink.

exampleSentences.english: We have tea at half past six.
